summary_1line: Garuda offers to carry Galava across the world and describes the sacred significance of the eastern and southern cosmic directions.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda, the विशाल golden eagle, stands before the sage Galava offering to carry him across the ocean and the ends of the earth.
The radiant sun rises in the eastern quarter while gods perform sacrifices and sacred fires blaze beneath the dawn sky.
The dark southern realm of Yama appears with the river Vaitarani flowing thick with the bodies of the condemned amid impenetrable gloom.
